reviews.name: June
reviews.text:
It's been an exciting experience working with Disco Sundays LLC Recording Studio!!! Melvin Thomas is Patient, Professional, and Thorough!!! I was nervous upon my first session; however, the accomodations provided made me feel more comfortable. Now that my project is nearing completion, I have developed more confidence and I am anxiously awaiting the roll out of my finished project!!!
Thanks So Much For All Of Your Support
Melvin and Disco Sundays LLC Recording Studio for this opportunity!!!

reviews.name: Kikuyu Sweeney JR
reviews.text: Great experience & cool vibes! DJ crazy talented & can work with just about anything!

reviews.name: Brandon Crump
reviews.text: Wonderful atmosphere, clean, comfortable and  well managed! Melvin, the engineer, was extremely patient and skillful! Definitely would recommend!

reviews.name: Dara Kamilah
reviews.text: Very professional delivery and awesome Artist Development Program. I’m always learning something new from Melvin and Xavier. Disco Sundays has gone above and beyond catering to my music and brand and I’m very excited for what more work is to come when collaborating with them still.

reviews.name: Jason Bain
reviews.text: To whom this may concern, working with these gentlemen, were phenomenal, they were extremely helpful, great at all cylinders, they really do a great job, please believe me.

reviews.name: Henrisch Bata
reviews.text: Great place to record your songs! Melvin is excellent, patient and very professional. On top of that, their services are affordable. I’ll go back there for sure. Thank you!

reviews.name: Ajibola Michael
reviews.text: Great absolutely awesome 🥹🤎

reviews.name: Ipoola Olajumoke
reviews.text: I had a great experience.

reviews.name: Ebenezer Ayodele
reviews.text: Excellent studio, thanks for the great service

reviews.name: charles ludlow
reviews.text: recently purchased the membership and can honestly say its one of the best investments ive made the scheduling is flexible the studio is a great vibe and the engineer really understands how to make your vision come to life

reviews.name: Marcus Howard
reviews.text: One of the best studios; if not, the best studio to record @. I’ve been working with Mel for a while and there’s no better producer I’d love to work in Maryland besides him. He knows your sound your melody and more importantly he knows you as an artist. A good listener and leader. Highly recommended

reviews.name: RICHY DOLLAR
reviews.text: Very accommodating and doing an impressive job.LLC.Melvin 🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥

reviews.name: HOLY SPIRITS child pure
reviews.text: Excellent engineer with tons of skills and experience. The membership is a mind blowing and irresistible deal I highly recommend any artist trying to get a lot of music recorded to sign up with Melvin here at Disco Sundays!

reviews.name: Rashid Brown
reviews.text: If you take yourself serious as a artist and you in the dmv you need to be tapping in bro goin get you right and you not getting taxed like most spots

reviews.name: Aaron Buchanan-Newton
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a professional creative space this is definitely a place to check out

reviews.name: Dimaggio Butler
reviews.text: Solid setup with professional workflow, will definitely book again

reviews.name: Jason Geise
reviews.text: The staff members that I had the opportunity to work with are extremely professional and insanely knowledgeable about music. I was able to record multiple types of tracks and receive the finished versions back. The finished versions sound great and professionally finished. I can’t wait to feature the work on my first EP.

reviews.name: Alex Costley
reviews.text: The best studio in the State. Flexible Hours with a completely open and creative space. Wonderful recording studio with a live drum kit as well for bands. Feel right at home at Disco Sundays. Won't be going anywhere else.

reviews.name: kyle thomas
reviews.text: He is him🙌🏽

reviews.name: Darren Bullford
reviews.text: BEST PRODUCTION AND QUALITY LOCALLY!!!  Producer will make you feel right at home while crafting your music to perfection! I 100% recommend this location to any artist looking to grow their brand and create a masterpiece album!!

reviews.name: Garry O'Neal, Jr.
reviews.text: Amazing studio!!
